purpose: Demo procurement eligibility guardrails. Configure for the relevant product, industry, and jurisdiction before real use.

rules.name: Required compliance evidence
rules.condition: Required legal/safety/compliance documentation is missing or unverified
rules.reason: Do not recommend purchase until a qualified human verifies requirements.

rules.name: Critical safety failure
rules.condition: A qualified reviewer confirms the product fails an applicable mandatory safety or legal requirement
rules.reason: Cost or carbon savings must not override a confirmed critical compliance failure.

rules.name: Missing data
rules.condition: Price, quantity, unit, delivery, specification, or emissions evidence is missing
rules.reason: Do not invent missing values; request evidence or mark as unknown.

rules.name: Like-for-like comparison
rules.condition: Alternatives differ in technical specification, quality, quantity, or compatibility
rules.reason: Compare only functionally suitable products or require expert approval.

note: These are product-design guardrails, not legal advice or a determination of applicable law.
